description.narrative:
The objective of the project is to facilitate the socio­ economic development of Uganda by upgrading the road link between Rwenkunye- Apac- Lira - Acholibur by improving road surface, road safety and increasing the overall efficiency of road transport system.
The development of this road will enhance Uganda’s competitiveness as a regional hub linking the neighboring countries. The completed project road will facilitate long haul fast movement of freight as well as support economic development of strategic sectors like agriculture, mining, tourism and oil and gas.
